description: Phase 0.5 gold set: 12 known-answer cases. Inputs are blind plain-language idea descriptions; answers are hidden in answers/answers.json.

eligibility.kind: granted: B, B1, B2, C (CN: B). Exception for the DE stratum: B3/B4 (see compromises)
eligibility.excluded_phase0: every publication and family_id in phase0/runs/idea-01/{candidates,expansion,details,details_expansion}.json and phase0/runs/control-01/candidates.json, plus the family of JP-4616127-B2; publications mapped to their family via the extract

excluded_counts.note: union of key-based parse and a regex sweep of publication numbers anywhere in the raw files (incl. knn:/sim: hit strings), each mapped to family via the extract; no selected family collides

pool_sizes.note: primary code = first element of the cpc array

selection_method: Per stratum, deterministic pseudo-random samples (order by hash(publication_number||seed)) of eligible documents, optionally narrowed by keywords such as sensor/motor/control/brake to favour technically substantive abstracts, then hand-picked for a concrete solution with 4-6 identifiable features, topic diversity, and no shared family or assignee+topic between cases. Case numbers were shuffled across strata.

strata.S1: core: hand carts / patient beds and lifts, primary CPC B62B or A61G (4)
strata.S2: outside usual starting codes: one each of B60B33, B60K7, B62D51, B66F9 as primary CPC (4)
strata.S3: Japanese documents with empty CPC, IPC/FI only (2)
strata.S4: machine-translated English abstract: one CN, one DE (2)

leak_check.method: source = html-unescaped abstract_en + title_en with boilerplate and reference numerals stripped; input = idea_text + feature texts; lower-cased word tokens with light plural folding; shared n-grams n>=3 excluding stop-word-only n-grams (the report lists maximal shared spans; every shared 3+-gram is contained in one of them); distinctive overlap = unique source word types of >=6 letters (non-stop) that reappear in the input / all such types
leak_check.flag_rules: shared n-gram of >=4 words; distinctive overlap > 35%; full title or any non-stop title 2-gram in input; any digit in input; idea_text outside 120-200 words; features outside 4-6

scorer.hit: any publication of the answer family (answers family_members, or family_id via the extract)

compromises: S4 DE: no DE document with kind B/B1/B2/C has a machine-translated abstract in the extract (DE B: 1255, B2: 884, C: 3623 rows, all untranslated; C2 has 230 translated but none meet the other criteria), so the DE case uses a B4 (German granted patent, no prior A publication);  Pool of eligible translated DE B3/B4: 2671.

S1 is read broadly as 'carts or patient-handling equipment' with primary CPC in B62B/A61G: it includes a patient hoist and a powered medical-equipment carriage, not only carts and beds, to keep topics diverse.
Some topics recur across strata (patient chairs, industrial trucks), but no two cases share a family or an assignee+topic.
Family sizes in the extract vary (2 to 12 members); larger families are easier to hit.
